python3 <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
root = Path('/Users/nabhag/OpenSource/kit/website/content/docs')
# Find fenced ts/go blocks missing import when they use package symbols
symbols_ts = re.compile(r'\b(Client|daytona|modal|LifecycleCapability|PolicyMode|ErrorKind|SandboxError)\b')
symbols_go = re.compile(r'\b(sandbox\.|daytona\.|modal\.|os\.|fmt\.|time\.|context\.|errors\.|log\.)')
for path in sorted(root.glob('*.mdx')):
    text = path.read_text()
    for m in re.finditer(r'```(ts|go)\n(.*?)```', text, re.S):
        lang, code = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        has_import = 'import ' in code or code.strip().startswith('package ')
        if lang == 'ts' and symbols_ts.search(code) and not has_import:
            # Client/daytona used without import
            first = code.strip().splitlines()[0][:80]
            print(f'{path.name} TS missing import: {first}')
        if lang == 'go' and symbols_go.search(code) and not has_import:
            first = code.strip().splitlines()[0][:80]
            print(f'{path.name} Go missing import: {first}')
print('done')
PY
